subject: general
question: Which of the following is a traditional dance form of Sri Lanka?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Kandyan dance.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kandyan dance** is a traditional dance form of **Sri Lanka** that originated in the **Kandy region**.
 
• It is also known as **Udarata Natum** and is performed in traditional **Sinhalese music.**
 
• The dance involves** complex footwork, acrobatic movements**, and intricate hand gestures.
 
• The performers wear **colorful costumes** and elaborate **headdresses.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bihu** is a folk dance form of** Assam** that is performed during the **Bihu festival.**

 
 
• It signals the start of the **harvest season** and the approach of **spring.**
 
• By celebrating the event, people express their gratitude to the gods for a **bountiful harvest** and ask for their blessings for the following year. 
 
 
 
• **Kathak** is a classical dance form that originated in **North India **and is known for its** intricate footwork **and **expressive gestures**.
 
 
• It is the classical dance form from **Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• The tradition holds that the **storytellers, or Kathakars**, who traveled throughout ancient northern India, are the source of Kathak.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is a classical dance form of **South India** that is known for its** grace, precision, and storytelling**.
 
 
• It involves **intricate footwork, hand gestures**, and **facial expressions.**
